item.title: Google Gemini for macOS adds computer use for multi-step tasks
item.description:
Google Gemini for macOS adds computer use for multi-step tasks

Google’s Gemini app for macOS now includes a computer use feature that enables the AI assistant to perform multi-step tasks across local files, desktop applications, and the web.

🔍 Overview

  • Gemini can now help users “get multi-step tasks done across your local files, desktop apps, and the web”
  • Google suggests the feature is useful for speeding up workflows, filling in forms, making presentations, and listing items for sale
  • The company says Gemini can better help with filling in forms and creative workflows with this new capability

🧩 How it works

  • Users decide which apps Gemini can access
  • A background window shows a live preview in the chat so users can follow along as Gemini works

⚙️ Key details

  • Computer use enables interaction with local files, desktop apps, and web content
  • Supported use cases include form filling, presentation creation, sales listings, and general workflow acceleration
  • The feature operates within user-granted app permissions

🚀 Availability

  • Rolling out now in English for users in the US
  • Settings preview appeared with this week’s macOS 27.3 beta

💡 Why it matters

  • Google is introducing computer use ahead of Apple launching new restrictions for apps requesting “full disk access” on Mac
  • Apple’s planned restrictions cite potential risks from AI agents with computer use capabilities

#Google #Gemini #macOS #AIagents #computeruse

Source: Gemini on Mac can now use your computer

item.title: Eido 0.0.2 Adds Browser Automation and Localization to Native AI Workspace
item.description:
Eido 0.0.2 Adds Browser Automation and Localization to Native AI Workspace

Eido 0.0.2 is now available for Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 13 or later. This update introduces browser and desktop automation capabilities, expanded localization options, and interface refinements for the native AI workspace built on Zed and the official pi agent.

🌐 Localization Updates

The interface now supports English and Simplified Chinese. Users can select Follow System, English, or 简体中文 at the top of the Settings menu. While common Eido controls and menus are localized, user content, code, model output, and tool identifiers remain unchanged.

🖥️ Interface Refinements

Several visual and usability improvements have been applied to the workspace:

  • Interface and conversation text default to 16px.
  • Ordinary completed tasks no longer leave a detached “Run finished” label; important status messages stay aligned with the input area.
  • Existing custom font preferences are preserved.
  • Users can drag the empty area in the top toolbar to move a non-fullscreen window on macOS.

🌐 Browser and Computer Use

The update introduces experimental features for extending tasks to websites and desktop applications. These capabilities are disabled by default and require separate DeepSeek service configuration. The release includes Chromium and its desktop driver. Users can also connect an existing Poki MCP installation to supported iPhone workflows, though Poki and device preparation are separate setup steps. Automation compatibility varies by website, application, and device.

To enable Computer Use, users must update global settings and grant specific macOS permissions:

  1. Open System Settings → Privacy & Security.
  2. Allow Eido under Accessibility and Screen & System Audio Recording (called Screen Recording on some macOS versions).
  3. Restart Eido.

These permissions allow input and window capture. Note that replacing a locally signed build can require re-enabling these permissions, and permission previously granted to a standalone Cua Driver does not apply to Eido.

🧩 Workflow and Configuration

The update retains pi’s public configuration and authentication interfaces while updating runtime adaptation. Key workflow features include:

  • Reference relevant files with @ and attach supporting material.
  • Continue earlier tasks with their saved context.
  • Review proposed file changes in the native editor before accepting them.
  • Search and fetch sources, inspect saved evidence, extract PDF/image text, and connect requirements with proposed changes and checks.

Model and thinking controls are located beside the composer in AI → pi Models & Credentials. Configuration and task history are stored outside the application bundle and are preserved during local updates.

⚙️ Key Details

  • Bundled Agent: pi 1.5.2
  • Signing Status: Locally signed; has not been notarized by Apple.
  • Release Assets: Include SHA-256 checksums, Eido source, and corresponding source for the native components.

#Eido #Zed #AIWorkspace #BrowserAutomation #macOS #PiAgent

Source: tony3liu/eido

item.title: MobileBuildMCP Launches AI Development Toolkit for iOS and macOS Projects
item.description:
MobileBuildMCP Launches AI Development Toolkit for iOS and macOS Projects

MobileBuildMCP introduces a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server and CLI designed to enhance agent workflows for iOS and macOS development projects. The toolkit ships as a single package offering direct terminal access and an MCP server for AI coding agents, supporting flexible installation via global binary or npx without requiring a global install. It requires macOS 14.5 or later, Xcode 16.x or later, and Node.js 18.x or later (though the latter is not required for Homebrew installation).

#AI #DeveloperTools #iOS #macOS #MCP #MobileDevelopment

item.title: open-computer-use expands platform support and adds macOS Locked Use
item.description:
open-computer-use expands platform support and adds macOS Locked Use

open-computer-use, an open‑source Computer Use service wrapped as MCP, has expanded its platform support and added a macOS locked‑use feature.

🔍 Overview

  • open-computer-use is an open‑source Computer Use service wrapped as MCP.
  • Inspired by OpenAI’s Codex Computer Use.
  • Built on Accessibility to create non‑intrusive CUA.

🧩 How It Works

  • Any AI agent or MCP client can run Computer Use on macOS, Linux, and Windows.
  • Gemini CLI connects through MCP to run full Computer Use actions.
  • In Codex App and Codex CLI, it matches official experience.

⚙️ Key Details

Installation

  • Install the skill directly.
  • Install for Codex.
  • Install for Claude Code.
  • Update an existing global install, including Codex install created above.
  • Manually download and install the open‑computer‑use skill.

Usage

  • Call a single Computer Use tool and print the MCP‑style JSON result.
  • Run a sequence in one process to reuse element_index state.
  • Sequence sleeps 1s between successful operations by default.

Permissions

  • On macOS, run once and grant Accessibility and Screen Recording.
  • Windows and Linux do not require this step.
  • Check permissions; onboarding opens only when missing.
  • macOS: query permission JSON without opening onboarding.

Configuration

  • ocu supports global configuration starting with version 1.0.0.
  • Default configuration file: ~/.config/ocu/config.json.

Locked Use (macOS)

  • Locked Use is now supported on macOS.
  • OCU temporarily unlocks the Mac after it has been locked so the agent can continue working.
  • Protective services such as a full‑screen shield are in place during use.
  • See the Locked Use guide for setup, installed components, and permissions.

Runtime Requirements (macOS)

Requirement Detail
macOS version 14.0 or later
Permissions Accessibility & Screen Recording
Steps Run once to grant permissions

🚀 Availability

  • Running on Linux.
  • macOS runtime requires macOS 14.0+.
  • Windows and Linux require no special permissions.

💡 Why it Matters

  • Has become one of the most useful workflows for nearly 100 % AI‑generated projects.
  • Built on open source, enabling quick setup with the harness template.
  • Offers a non‑intrusive, accessibility‑based solution for Computer Use across major OSes.

For more on the methodology behind this project, see the post at https://www.ifuryst.com/blog/2026/speedrunning-the-ai-era/

#OpenAI #ComputerUse #AIAgents #macOS #Accessibility

Source: iFurySt/open-computer-use

item.title: Google launches AI Edge Foresight, an offline‑only note‑taking app for macOS
item.description:
Google launches AI Edge Foresight, an offline‑only note‑taking app for macOS

Google has released an experimental note‑taking app called Google AI Edge Foresight that can transcribe meetings and audio files entirely offline.

🔍 Overview

  • Experimental app, free to use
  • Runs on macOS using Google’s on‑device EmbeddingGemma 2 model
  • Transcribes meetings completely offline

🧩 How it works

  • Audio is processed by an on‑device model; no cloud connection is required
  • The model runs locally on Macs with Apple Silicon

⚙️ Features

  • Offline transcription of meetings and audio files
  • Summarizes meetings while providing a space for personal notes, similar to Granola and Wispr Flow
  • Turns shorthand bullet points entered during a meeting into polished notes based on the transcript
  • Built‑in assistant lets you ask questions about the content you heard
  • Ability to connect local files for the assistant to reference when answering questions
  • Files, meeting audio, and notes never leave your computer

🚀 Availability

  • Free to use
  • Optimized for macOS on Apple Silicon Macs only

💡 Why it matters

  • Operates entirely on‑device, keeping data private
  • Provides a privacy‑focused alternative in the growing AI note‑taking market

#Google #AI #NoteTaking #macOS #Privacy

Source: Google’s AI note-taking app transcribes your meetings completely offline

item.title: Open‑Source RemoveMacAI Tool Deletes Apple Intelligence Models, Frees Up Storage
item.description:
Open‑Source RemoveMacAI Tool Deletes Apple Intelligence Models, Frees Up Storage

A new open‑source command‑line utility called RemoveMacAI lets macOS users delete Apple Intelligence models and disable its bundled AI features in a single step, reclaiming roughly a dozen gigabytes of disk space.

🔧 What RemoveMacAI Does

  • ‘RemoveMacAI’ switches off Apple’s AI features, deletes its AI models, and blocks them from being downloaded again.
  • It removes the on‑disk foundation models, which the developer says take up about 12 GB of space (some users report even more).
  • The changes persist across macOS updates.
  • Dictation continues to work after removal.
  • The tool provides a removemacai revert command to re‑enable all features and allow the models to download again.
  • A removemacai status command shows the size of each individual AI model on the Mac.

“I wrote RemoveMacAI to do all of it in one go.”

📦 Storage Impact

  • Apple Intelligence models remain on disk by default, occupying about 12 GB according to the developer.
  • A user measured 35.05 GB of space labeled “Apple Intelligence” on a MacBook Air.
  • Running RemoveMacAI deletes these models, freeing the corresponding storage.

⚙️ How It Works

  1. The tool toggles off the following AI‑related features:
    • Siri
    • Writing Tools
    • Genmoji
    • Image Playground
    • The ChatGPT extension
    • All summary functions
  2. It then deletes the stored foundation models from the file system.
  3. Finally, it prevents macOS from re‑downloading the models unless the user runs removemacai revert.

📋 Feature List

Feature Action performed by RemoveMacAI
Siri Turned off
Writing Tools Turned off
Genmoji Turned off
Image Playground Turned off
ChatGPT extension Turned off
Summaries Turned off

📆 Availability

  • The utility is open‑source and was announced by its developer on Reddit.
  • It replaces the single Settings toggle that existed for disabling Apple Intelligence before it was removed in macOS 27, where the models stayed on disk and settings were split across multiple panes (including several under Screen Time).

💡 Why It Matters

  • Users who prefer not to run Apple’s on‑device AI can now remove the models entirely, reclaiming storage without losing core functionality like Dictation.
  • The tool simplifies what previously required navigating about a dozen settings across various preference panes.
  • By blocking future downloads, it ensures the storage savings remain until the user decides to restore the features.

#AppleIntelligence #macOS #OpenSource #CLI

Source: An open-source tool lets you delete 12GB of Apple Intelligence data on macOS

item.title: Apple to Tighten Mac Full Disk Access Controls Amid AI Agent Risks
item.description:
Apple to Tighten Mac Full Disk Access Controls Amid AI Agent Risks

Apple has announced plans to tighten the way apps are granted Full Disk Access on macOS, citing growing risks as AI agents become more capable and autonomous. The company warned that this broad permission can expose highly sensitive data and bypasses the privacy controls normally used to protect user data.

🔍 Overview

Full Disk Access is one of the broadest permissions available in macOS. While it is intended for software like backup tools, it allows apps to reach data that is otherwise protected behind separate privacy controls. Apple reports that some developers are currently using this permission in ways that could put users at risk by exposing several types of data:

  • Personal files
  • Email messages
  • Messages
  • Browsing history
  • Sensitive data across large parts of a system

⚙️ Key Details

Apple directly linked the upcoming changes to the rise of agentic AI software. Unlike traditional apps that might need access for a single function, AI agents can carry out tasks across multiple apps, files, and services.

Feature Description
Permission Level One of the broadest in macOS; bypasses standard privacy controls.
Original Intent Designed for utilities such as backup software.
Current Concern AI agents may expose significantly more personal info than traditional apps.
Privacy Stance Positioned as a central part of Apple’s on-device and cloud-based AI processing.

🧩 How it Works

The company intends to introduce additional controls that require more explicit user action before an app can receive Full Disk Access. The goal of these protections is to ensure users clearly understand the risks involved and make a deliberate, informed decision before granting such broad access to their data.

🚀 Availability

Apple has not announced exactly what the new Full Disk Access controls will look like or when they will arrive. The company stated only that the additional protections will be introduced going forward as it continues to expand artificial intelligence across the Mac through Apple Intelligence and Siri AI.

#Apple #macOS #AIAgents #Privacy #Cybersecurity

Source: Apple plans tougher Mac Full Disk Access controls as AI agents expand

item.title: Meta Patches Zero-Day Vulnerability in Muse macOS App
item.description:
Meta Patches Zero-Day Vulnerability in Muse macOS App

Meta has released a hotfix for its Muse macOS app to address a zero-day vulnerability that could allow an attacker to take control of the AI agent.

🧩 How it works

Security researcher Patrick Wardle discovered a bug involving an undocumented Muse setting. This flaw allowed attackers running local code to:

  • Redirect transcription processing from Meta’s servers to their own endpoint.
  • Gain access to the user’s Muse account.

Wardle’s proof-of-concept attacks demonstrated the ability to write malicious files to disk and take pictures, often without alerting the user.

⚙️ Key details

Several design decisions contributed to the vulnerability:

  • Muse dictation occurs in the cloud rather than on-device.
  • Any app is permitted to control all undocumented settings within Muse.

💡 Why it matters

Meta asserts that real-world security concerns were minimal because the exploit required local access to the user’s device. David Singleton of Meta Superintelligence Labs stated on X: “This was a local privilege escalation attack, not a remote exploit. Using it to do harm therefore requires malicious code already running on the user’s machine under their user account and the practical risk to users of the Muse Mac app was therefore quite low.”

🚀 Availability

While the app has faced a security flaw and was recently blocked from Amazon’s e-commerce platform, the launch has seen significant growth:

  • Estimated downloads of the Muse mobile app in the US and Canada outpaced ChatGPT’s 12-day debut.
  • Meta stock rose by 11 percent on Monday.

#Meta #Muse #Cybersecurity #macOS #AIagents

Source: Meta patches Muse exploit that let attackers control the AI agent

item.title: Apple Updates Software with New Apple Intelligence Features and Platform Improvements
item.description:
Apple Updates Software with New Apple Intelligence Features and Platform Improvements

Apple has released software updates delivering a new generation of Apple Intelligence features and platform improvements for its devices, including the 2027 software releases.

🧠 Apple Intelligence Features

Apple Intelligence introduces tools to make daily apps smarter and more useful:

Feature Capability
Photos Includes Spatial Reframing, Extend, and an upgraded Clean Up tool for editing photos.
Image Playground Creates high-quality images in various styles, including photorealistic, with metadata and upcoming SynthID support.
Safari Automatically organizes tabs into topics, notifies users of website changes (price drops or restocks), and enables custom extensions based on descriptions.
Call Context Surfaces relevant information, such as reservation numbers or confirmation codes, during business calls.

🛡️ Parental Controls and Safety

New features allow parents to create safer digital experiences for children:

  • Account Setup: A new flow for child accounts simplifies enabling age-based safeguards.
  • App Management: Parents can choose specific apps children access and add more over time.
  • Safari: “Ask to Browse” requires parental approval before children access new websites.
  • Communication Safety: Blocks gore or violent content in shared images and videos, and allows parents to approve new contacts.
  • Screen Time: A redesigned intuitive view shows average device usage and top apps. This includes Schedules to manage app access at different times of the day and daily total time allowances for Social Media, Games, and Entertainment apps.

⚙️ Platform and Performance Improvements

The 2027 software releases include several performance and design refinements:

  • Speed Increases:
    • iPhone and iPad: Apps launch up to 30% faster, photos load up to 70% faster, and AirDrop transfers are up to 80% faster.
    • iPad: File browsing and transfers to external USB drives are up to 5x faster; improvements to multitasking window management.
    • Apple Vision Pro: Wi-Fi connection and startup are up to 3x faster.
    • Apple Watch: Faster music playback.
  • Connectivity and Stability:
    • Seamless transitions between cellular and Wi-Fi on iPhone and iPad.
    • Messages now allows subsequent texts to go through while large media is being delivered in low-bandwidth situations.
    • Faster network file browsing on Mac.
    • More stable and comprehensive search across Mail, Photos, and Spotlight, with a new ranking system for Top Hits in Mail.
  • Design: Refinements using “Liquid Glass” include sharper app icons and a Settings slider to adjust the appearance from ultraclear to fully tinted.

#AppleIntelligence #iOS #macOS #SoftwareUpdate #ParentalControls

Source: Major updates for Apple’s software platforms are now available
